claim_boundaries: Device signatures prove key possession, not unmodified application attestation.
The delivery service cannot certify opaque MLS application semantics.
RemoveParticipant is an authenticated RPC, not a webhook.
JWT expiry does not itself disconnect an existing media session.
TURN peer-address protection is not anonymity from infrastructure/video hosts.
Authenticode/EV cannot guarantee suppression of SmartScreen warnings.
Artifact signatures alone do not prevent metadata freeze or replay/rollback.
A fully privileged endpoint rollback cannot be prevented by an unauthenticated local counter.
Zeroize and SQL DELETE do not prove erasure from SSDs, backups, swap or snapshots.
